changelog:
Initial release of the Create Destination Marketing Content skill.

- Enables generation of tourism promotional content for destinations.
- Designed for use by travel agencies, hotels, and tour operators.
- Provides a clear workflow for producing, refining, and optimizing marketing content.
- Utilizes chat, image generation, and web search APIs to enrich content.
- Includes SEO-focused keywords to improve discoverability.
- Recommends human review before external publication.
summary: Generate tourism promotional content for destinations. Use when working on destination marketing for travel agencies, hotels, tour operators.
